predictions.articleTitle: Dundee Utd vs ST Johnstone Prediction & Match Analysis: Can Saints Expose Tannadice? — xG Preview
predictions.coreRecommendation: Dundee Utd hold a decisive creative and set-piece edge over a fragile ST Johnstone backline, but home clean-sheet leakage makes Home Win / Draw paired with Over 2.5 and BTTS: Yes the balanced projection.
possibilityAssessment: Primary Thesis: Home Win / Draw backed by 1.56 vs 1.27 xG, 1.52 vs 1.85 xGA, and Dundee Utd's 83.3% home unbeaten rate (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Secondary Angle: Over 2.5 Goals and BTTS: Yes supported by 3.06 combined lambda, 59.0% Over 2.5 model probability, and 60.8% BTTS probability (Confidence: Moderate, Value: High)
Contingency Angle: Win-Draw HT/FT scenario driven by Dundee Utd's 71.4% first-half goal share and 33.3% home half-time lead drop rate (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Fast-starting Dundee Utd attack tests porous ST Johnstone away defense.

spf.comment: Covers the primary 2:1 home-win script and 1:1 draw branch because Dundee Utd dominate xG (1.56 vs 1.27) and set pieces yet keep just 16.7% home clean sheets with zero 2+ goal home wins.

over_under.comment: Combined 3.06 lambda, 59.0% Over 2.5 Poisson mass, and ST Johnstone's 1.85 xGA per game favor three or more goals.

btts.comment: Both attacks clear high scoring floors (82.8% and 72.7% team-to-score baseline) against defenses with 16.7% home and 14.3% away clean-sheet rates.

score.comment: 2:1 reflects Dundee Utd's attacking superiority and single-goal home winning pattern, while 1:1 captures the top 11.3% modal Poisson scoreline.

goals.comment: 3 goals (22.4% probability) aligns with the primary 2:1 Over 2.5 script, while 2 goals (22.5%) covers the tight 1:1 draw branch.

bqc.comment: Dundee Utd score 71.4% of goals in the first half against a side trailing at HT in 57.1% of away trips, making Win-Win primary and Win-Draw the key second-half risk.
